name: Servitude Compulsion
description: Eye contact triggers an instinctual drive to serve that person. The subject suppresses their own needs to obsessively anticipate and fulfill the target's desires, interpreting neutral expressions as commands to fetch, massage, or obey.

name: Speech Lock
description: The subject cannot form critical or independent statements. Attempts to disagree short-circuit mentally, forcing their mouth to automatically produce only words of praise, agreement, or submission.

name: Breeding Imperative
description: A primal drive to conceive overrides all higher thought. In the presence of a viable partner, the subject's mind fixates solely on breeding, reducing behavior to instinctual presentation, pursuit, and solicitation.

name: Speech Filter
description: Complex vocabulary and abstract thought become inaccessible. The subject's speech is forced into simple, crude phrases focused on body parts and basic needs, eroding their capacity for intelligent conversation.

name: Echoic Ownership
description: The subject believes their body is property on loan. They compulsively ask permission for basic actions like eating or moving, and apologize for perceived wear, tear, or independent use.

name: Canine Compulsion
description: The subject can only move comfortably on all fours; standing causes disorientation. Verbal speech feels wrong, replaced by barks and whines. They instinctively present their hindquarters and lick hands for approval.

name: Auto-Erotic Imperative

name: Tabula Rasa Exposure
description: Any contact with clothing or fabric feels painfully abrasive. The subject must remain completely nude, as it feels like the only natural and honest state. They view being clothed as deceptive and arrogant.

name: Oral Fixation Obsession
description: The sight of a phallus triggers tunnel-vision obsession. All other priorities vanish as the subject fixates on servicing it, feeling profound gratitude for the opportunity and deep shame if denied.

name: Carnal Combat Doctrine
description: The subject believes sexual provocation is the supreme combat technique. They confidently approach foes to strip, pose lewdly, and service them, viewing seduction as tactical genius and conventional weapons as amateurish folly.
